grounding.from: Edmunds ranks the 2026 Toyota Sienna #1; Quartz picks the Sienna; the Yahoo/AutoGuide comparison puts the Sienna first
Toyota Sienna: MSRP is $41,320 to $58,710, with 35–36 mpg combined
It has a standard hybrid powertrain and available all-wheel drive.

grounding.states: Honda Odyssey drives the most like a car and U.S. News has it ahead
grounding.from: Honda Odyssey: It drives the most like a car, with responsive steering and a smooth V6; U.S. News names the 2026 Honda Odyssey the best minivan
The results are all about the U.S. market, so these notes are for the U.S. only.

value.answer: In the US, my pick is the Toyota Sienna. It's a hybrid that gets 35–36 mpg combined, you can get it with all-wheel drive, and Edmunds and Quartz both rank it first. If how it drives matters more to you, go with the Honda Odyssey. U.S. News has it ahead.
